note: From the OpenStreetMap export (OSM's main API, 13 October 2026; tools/osm-to-kit.mjs) and the view from above (docs/reference/aerial/rose-hill.jpg), at real scale across the line like the tracks: the end of the Rose Hill branch, a single track with one platform about 90 m long (u -45 to 45) on its west side, 1.68 m from the track; the small station building behind the platform (u -3 to 11), the station car park (Rose Hill Railway Station) west of it, reached off Railway Road, footpaths from the platform to the car park and up to Stockport Road (A626), which crosses the line on bridge 48 at the north (Manchester) end (u 55 to 66); the old line on to Macclesfield (now the Middlewood Way) runs on south, and the trackbed of the old second line lies east of the platform. A terminus: trains run in from the north and turn round here, so passengers wait both ways on the one platform. The buffer stops stand about 20 m beyond the platform's south end (placed by eye from buffers-1.jpg and platform-south-1.jpg); trains stop 6 m north of the station's point so a six-car unit clears them, a two-car one stands on the platform as it is, and a four-car one once it's extended north to the bridge (`longest`; a six-car one stands off the north end, as at a real short platform). Positive v is east. Photos (docs/reference/photos/rose-hill: carpark-1.jpg, platform-1.jpg, platform-north-1.jpg and platform-south-1.jpg DS Pugh 2026, buffers-1.jpg Kevin Waterhouse 2024, area-bridge-1.jpg Gerald England 2013): the building is single-storey red brick under a pitched slate roof (drawn hipped) with a short canopy over the platform (the canopy, longer in the game); a timber fence and planters along the platform's back; a rusty old track beside the live one at the south end (drawn as rails to the old trackbed). The bridge is a flat deck on brick abutments. No footbridge or second platform: neither stage is offered. The lifts are the game's, up to Stockport Road by the path at the north end. The cycle stands are the export's (covered, by the car park). The car park is the export's outline split in two, drawn as rectangles; the rail replacement buses stand on the forecourt (from memory, placed by eye); the bus link at Stop A ('Stockport Road / The Drive') on the A626, from the export and area-bus-stop-1.jpg. No taxi rank. Lamps and the departure board placed by eye; the shop is the game's. Across the line at real scale since 13 October 2026 (it was 1.25 times).
